flags.name: Flag 1 - XSS
flags.description:
<s1-nav>Find the Alerts view from the menu on the left.</s1-nav>
<s1-flag-body>
From the Alerts view, locate the Alert cluster that has CF-WAF-XSS — Cross-Site Scripting against shop.soledrop.co (WAF ML score) in the Alert name column.
</s1-flag-body>
<s1-flag example="30">The flag is the number of alerts in this cluster.</s1-flag>

flags.name: Flag 2 - XSS
flags.description:
<s1-nav>Find the Alerts view from the menu on the left. 
From the Alerts view, locate the Alert cluster that has CF-WAF-XSS — Cross-Site Scripting against shop.soledrop.co (WAF ML score) in the Alert name column. Click on any one of these alerts.</s1-nav>
<s1-flag-body>
Use the Purple AI Alert Description to find the MITRE ATT&CK reference associated with exploitation of public-facing applications.
</s1-flag-body>
<s1-flag example="T####">The flag is the MITRE ATT&CK ID</s1-flag>

hints.description:
Read through the Purple AI Alert Description.

Find the MITRE ATT&CK ID that comes right before (exploitation of public-facing applications).

The code follows the following format: T####.

flags.name: Flag 3 - XSS - Workflow
flags.description:
<s1-nav>Find the Alerts view from the menu on the left. 
From the Alerts view, locate the Alert cluster that has CF-WAF-XSS — Cross-Site Scripting against shop.soledrop.co (WAF ML score) in the Alert name column. Click on any one of these alerts.</s1-nav>
<s1-flag-body>

Click on the Automate button in the top right of the Alert popup.

HyperAutomation workflows allow Threat Hunters to enrich alerts, gather third-party threat intel, seek out determinitions from analysts, and conduct follow-up responses automatically whenever alerts are triggered.

</s1-flag-body>
<s1-flag example="S1-CNAPP-AppAttack">The flag is the name of the workflow under 'Available Workflows'</s1-flag>
